scope: MainViewModel.kt entirely: job lifetime, cancellation, shares while busy, draft read/write/retry channels; baseline b89b957b32b2c9d73bfff505fecdf0abfadd5cf7. Static review only; NativeProcessSession and service excluded.

findings.title: The 120-second analysis timeout cannot cancel the synchronous direct probe
evidence: MainViewModel.kt:99 wraps direct analyze in withTimeout(120_000), while actual direct.cancel() is deferred to the catch at 287-290 or 209-212.

DirectDownloader.kt:68-71 runs the request inside withContext(Dispatchers.IO); request() blocks in call.execute() at line 56 and has no coroutine cancellation handler. NetworkSettings.client preserves the six-hour callTimeout from DirectDownloader.kt:311.
A cancelled withContext waits for its blocking IO block to finish, so the timeout catch cannot close the call while it is blocking.
reproduction: Use an owned public HTTPS endpoint whose HEAD response delivers incomplete headers slowly, with at least one byte every ten seconds, for more than 120 seconds. This avoids the 30-second inactivity read timeout.
Analyze this URL in single or batch mode and wait 120 seconds. The coroutine is cancelled, but busy/batchBusy remains set and no timeout result is shown until the synchronous HEAD finishes or fails.
Manual Cancel does invoke direct.cancel(), confirming the missing link is specifically timeout-driven cancellation.
findings.impact: The promised two-minute bound is ineffective for direct probes; one slow origin can hold the single analysis or block the remaining batch for much longer.
findings.suggested_fix: Connect cancellation of the analyzing coroutine to the active OkHttp Call at the request boundary, or use a cancellable asynchronous OkHttp adapter; keep timeout cleanup independent of waiting for call.execute() to return.

findings.title: Accepting a pending multi-link share discards it when draft storage is in error
evidence: receive() stores shares while busy at 117-120.
acceptPending() clears pendingShared at 146 before calling receive(pending) at 147.
receive() dispatches two or more URLs to prepareBatch() at 122-124, but prepareBatch() silently returns when draftErrorMutable is true at 151.
AppRoot.kt:517-524 displays an enabled pending-share confirmation independently of batchStorageError, so the failing path is reachable in the UI.
reproduction: Cause draft.read() or draft.write() to fail, leaving batchStorageError=true. Single-link analysis remains permitted by analyze().
While single analysis is busy, share text containing two URLs; pendingShared now contains that text.
Cancel or finish analysis and press the pending-link dialog confirmation. acceptPending clears pendingShared, then prepareBatch returns immediately because of the storage error.
Retry storage successfully. The shared links are absent from the batch and no pending dialog remains.
findings.impact: A user-confirmed incoming share is silently lost during a recoverable storage failure; retrying storage cannot recover it.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not consume pendingShared until the selected receive path accepts it; preserve or defer multi-link input when draft storage is in error.

test_gaps.gap: No test found for MainViewModel timeout while DirectDownloader.call.execute remains blocked, or for cancellation followed immediately by another single/batch analysis.
test_gaps.suggested_test: Use an injected cancellable analyzer and an owned slow-header HTTP endpoint to verify deadline cancellation closes the call and clears busy before a new run.

test_gaps.gap: Existing BatchChoiceUiTest.storageFailureOffersRetryAndPreventsEnqueue tests only the composable flags. No MainViewModel tests found for read failure/retry, write failure with conflated revisions, initial restore racing a new draft, or ViewModel clearance during IO.
test_gaps.suggested_test: Inject draft storage with barriers and failures; assert latest accepted revision remains in memory, storage errors preserve user input, and saving becomes false only for the latest durable revision.

test_gaps.gap: ClipboardInputTest covers normal multi-link input but not pending acceptance under storage failure, multiple shares while busy, cancellation, or batch busy.
test_gaps.suggested_test: Assert pending text is preserved until processing succeeds, including multi-link shares during a draft storage failure.
